scope: Read-only source/contract review before the one authorized execution; no candidate, test or reference execution

unit_runner.actual_collection_and_pass_count: Not executed; record actual pytest output, not a predeclared 30 or 33
unit_runner.runtime_priority: Prepend isolated runtime/hf_repo/src and import hf_eval before pytest configuration; require its actual package file to be the candidate package
unit_runner.budget_scope: Runner checks its process RSS/peak_wset at entry, per-item teardown and exit. The separate launcher supplies the outer deadline and any tree observer. This source review is not evidence of observed resource compliance.
unit_runner.call_accounting: Tests exercise mechanical and toy solver paths; runner explicitly says calls are not separately instrumented and does not report them as zero

final_external_probe.pre_freeze_action: Root must synchronize this author copy to the staged test. The sole change from the previous 83-line probe is context.clear_flags(), as authorized, before the exact Decimal reference arithmetic.

candidate_control_flow.force_calls: Exactly one call site, batch_response_split_numpy; started increments before the call and completed only after return
candidate_control_flow.tangent_calls: Exactly one call site, _tangent(response,...), consuming the retained full response. Static inspection of _tangent confirms it has no force call; the public batch_tangent_components entry that would evaluate force again is not used.
candidate_control_flow.source_scope: Isolated 41-source runtime is checked against original live pins; AST delta permits only the two selected matmul scales, candidate version and function docstring. Original production sources and capsules remain inputs.
candidate_control_flow.data_identity: Captured ordinal36/code, observation NPZ/field hashes, original inventory/freeze, 14 raw model overlaps, saved points and direction are checked. The split state SHA is independently reconstructed from representation prefix, little-endian ndof, raw lift and fluctuation.
candidate_control_flow.portable_bindings: All saved bindings are relative to production_root. The validator must be installed in the formal stage before running; its temporary external author path is not intended as a runtime path.
candidate_control_flow.outputs: Full force fields, including P/S and retained invariant high/low words, three unsymmetrized local tensors, local/global directional actions, all-DOF force scatters and three full CSC matrices
candidate_control_flow.partial_failure: Input/fixture/source snapshots are saved before evaluation. Full force fields are saved immediately after a successful force call and before tangent. An exception records fail with actual started/completed counters; no retry is present. A later reference requires a passing candidate with one completed force and tangent.
candidate_control_flow.memory_scope: Cooperative sampled tree sum of max(RSS, Windows peak_wset), not an OS hard cap

reference_control_flow.production_imports: None in reference mode; only fixed-SHA Decimal helper copies are imported
reference_control_flow.fresh_HP_calls: Exactly one evaluate at 80 digits and one at 120 digits, with the original local split arrays and saved direction
reference_control_flow.global_numbering: Independent disjoint local numbering for HP, then exact 3000-digit scatter with Inexact trapped to the original edofs
reference_control_flow.CSC_validation: Load each full CSC, verify archive/raw fields, independently reassemble every saved local tensor coefficient, and compare its actual saved-direction action. This is saved coefficient/assembly checking, not fresh production mechanics or exhaustive HP matrix-column checking.
reference_control_flow.denominators: Force: total HP norm/floor maximum, component own norm versus 1e-12 total scale; action: own HP norm versus 1e-10. Original native rules are retained.
reference_control_flow.first_failure: The failing gate raises immediately; finally persists all checks/differences accumulated so far. Each completed HP raw gzip remains saved. No subsequent mathematical gate or retry occurs.
reference_control_flow.end_bindings: After successful comparison, original bindings, source capsules, HP helpers, candidate result, fixture, arrays, force fields and all three CSC archives are rehashed

limits: Static review cannot assert execution pass or observed budget compliance.
P/S have finite supported output checks; frozen HP reference does not expose independent stress tensors.
Only one saved direction has HP derivative checks; no all-column tangent qualification.
Captured F36 is a rejected trial state. This review and eventual force/Jv gates do not qualify equilibrium, contact or clamping.
Source and numeric checks after an exception are not claimed complete; fail receipts and partial files must remain immutable.
